settings.serialized_size_contract: native encoding differs; match useful bytes
settings.order: rate, repeat, protocol; protocol order rotates by repeat

measurement_boundaries.throughput: Unique origin-node completions per second, using disjoint origin observations; replicas are not summed as replicated system output.
measurement_boundaries.latency: Intended-arrival cohorts; admission to origin-local payload-verified contiguous output with censored p50/p95/p99 and independent scheduled-to-output accounting. Legacy adapters require explicit diagnostics mode.
measurement_boundaries.traffic: Sum of successful replica TCP stream writes, including protocol data, authentication, framing and application ACKs. Excludes metrics/client control, TCP/IP headers and kernel retransmissions. Reads recorded separately, never added to writes.
measurement_boundaries.conditions: Matched node count, hardware, offered useful workload, warmup and measurement duration. Native encoding, consensus units, workers, timeouts, cryptography and storage remain explicit. Native implementation comparison, not isolated protocol causality. Configured protocol bound matched; no added kernel delay, observed localhost network latency is not assumed zero.
measurement_boundaries.capacity: One1200tx/s offered-load point, one repetition and3s measurement; this is a local functional implementation pilot, not a sustainable-capacity estimate.
